summary: Layer 1B expansion found a narrow US-listed universe with plausible exposure to upstream transformer-component bottlenecks. The cleanest direct US-listed component mappings are grain-oriented electrical steel, electrical-steel laminations, and transformer bushings. No clean US-listed pure play was identified for CTC magnet wire, tap changers, or transformer-grade insulation in this pass; those remain coverage gaps. The underfollowed lane is led by Worthington Steel and Cleveland-Cliffs as electrical-steel and lamination suppliers tied to transformer cores, with PLPC included only as a speculative adjacent grid-hardware beneficiary rather than a direct transformer-component supplier. Hubbell is included as a large-cap reference anchor because it has identifiable transformer-bushing products, but it is not the main alpha-hunt target.
